Command.Comment: Read-only receipt transport diagnosis; no admission or resealing

commands:
set -eu
cd /opt/fyp-phase8-linux-v1
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/.venv-analysis/lib/python3.12/site-packages:$PWD/.venv-transport/lib/python3.12/site-packages
.venv/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import sys,hmac,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'artifacts/phase-8-review-freeze/v2'))
from controls import read,canonical,hash_file,policy_commitment,Policy
owner=Path('/var/lib/fyp-owner');secret=(owner/'owner.key').read_bytes();policy=Policy.model_validate(read(owner/'launch-policy.json'))
previous=None;results=[]
for kind in ('REVIEW_ACCEPTED','FREEZE','LAUNCH'):
 p=owner/'receipts'/f'{kind}.json';raw=read(p);body={k:v for k,v in raw.items() if k!='signature'}
 results.append({'kind':kind,'file_sha256':hash_file(p),'signature_valid':hmac.compare_digest(raw['signature'],hmac.new(secret,canonical(body),'sha256').hexdigest()),'predecessor_matches':raw['predecessor_hash']==previous,'expires_at':raw['expires_at'],'policy_matches':raw['policy_hash']==policy_commitment(policy,kind)})
 previous=hashlib.sha256(canonical(raw)).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({'receipts':results,'policy':policy.model_dump(mode='json'),'main_initialized':Path('/var/lib/p8/run').exists()}))
PY
